selection.description: Consumer-pulled packages that vault-seed can adopt before the full daily-driver release.

audienceBoundary.productLocal: Vault-specific CLI labels, copy, notebooks, routes, and UX stay downstream-owned.

consumerPull.downstreamUse: storage:v1 contract support for credentials:v1 wallet store/list/remove
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer vendors storage-contract-v1 as credentials-contract-v1 support while proving issue -> verify -> present -> wallet
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Durable wallet persistence, retention, encryption policy, and wallet UX remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: identity:v1 contract support for credentials:v1 issuer and holder proofs
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer vendors identity-contract-v1 as credentials-contract-v1 support while proving issue -> verify -> present
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Issuer trust, DID methods, account recovery, and identity UX remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Lab datasets, publication outbox, and notebook snapshot evidence
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer emits refarm.task-artifacts.v1 manifests from Lab/outbox/notebook producers
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Vault schemas, notebook UX, and frontmatter remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Channel destinations, rate limits, receipts, dry-run, and review gates
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer's Telegram adapter emits refarm.channel-delivery-envelope.v1
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Provider API calls, copy formatting, and inbox/outbox UX remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Reusable task/effort evidence for dgk operations and handoffs
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer's process flows attach effort identifiers to emitted evidence
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: dgk command vocabulary and operator UX remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Declared quality/lint profiles and reports for text, UI, and checker plugin POCs
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer and agent-demo POCs can declare quality intentions through quality:v1 while keeping domain profiles downstream-owned
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Rule catalogs, severity policy, product copy, personas, and rendered-subject collection remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: One provenance envelope (channel, origin locator, collection time, fingerprint, license, privacy) on every ingested or declared input a consumer keeps
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer stamps and verifies provenance:v1 on its own input records — notes, requirements, or a materials database — and can gate on the named checks while keeping its source vocabulary and evidence policy downstream-owned
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Source catalogs, licensing policy, which checks block, and the domain fields that ride beside provenance remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: source:v1 contract support for the source-web vendor packet
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer vendors source-contract-v1 as the source-web transitive override while proving source-web -> records:v1 -> enrichment:v1 composition
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Concrete login, selectors, and source profile vocabulary remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Deterministic enrichment report contract for records and note projections
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer emits enrichment:v1 reports from checkout-owned providers while the package supplies only the neutral contract and fixture provider
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Private registries, lookup adapters, tag vocabulary, and domain enrichment rules remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Neutral records:v1 manifest for source-linked knowledge/content evidence
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer validates requirement-like records and notes-to-records projections through records:v1 with a clean reference-vault composition proof
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: PARA placement, editorial model, note rendering, and domain labels remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Structured process runner primitive for dgk-runner and dgk-cli internals
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer's runner keeps run(cmd, args, opts) while using process-handoff internally
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: dgk package names, binary, commands, and product labels remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Generic doctor/substrate checks for node, pnpm, uv, Python, node_modules, executable shims, and devcontainer mounts
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer can replace dgk check-substrate internals with ToolchainAuditor while keeping dgk doctor UX and recovery copy downstream
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Project-specific command names, setup recommendations, required file policy, and health+quality composition remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Package acceptance, release planning, and publish dry-run policy
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer's release/package smoke consumes release-engine acceptance output
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Distribution identity, prose, and changelog content remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Shared crypto substrate needed by silo-backed credentials
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer's credential flow uses silo without local crypto stand-ins
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Credential policy choices and publishing identities remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Scoped credential collection and secret namespace separation
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer stores model/runtime/publishing credentials through silo namespaces
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Provider-specific publishing adapters and approval workflow remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Volatile storage:v1 implementation for credentials smoke and consumer-contract wallet proofs
consumerPull.proofTarget: sovereign-citizen:reference:test stores and lists the issued credential through storage-memory
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Production durability, synchronization, encryption-at-rest, and wallet UX remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: credentials:v1 contract for issue, policy-driven verify, present, store, list, remove, and revoke seams before VC UX
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer vendors credentials-contract-v1 early and proves issuer/verifier/wallet seams with trustedIssuers, trustSelf, holder-binding, and local signed status-list revocation checks before headspace UX
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Issuer authorities, credential schemas, trust registry sources, remote status-list distribution, trust UI, and domain vocabulary remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Channel/transport dispatch primitives — parseTaskTransport (file/http/channel:*), the control-surface adapter, and channel effort payloads that feed the runtime HTTP surface.
consumerPull.proofTarget: Consumers route channel/transport dispatch operations through these shared primitives. This is NOT a product-command/CLI registry — product commands stay in the consumer command layer (the old wording wrongly suggested modeling CLI commands on it).
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Surface labels, routes, and product-specific actions remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Lab/admin tokens, verde-jardim theme source, and build-free DS HTML document helpers
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer's Lab/admin UI imports ds tokens and renders documentHtml through @refarm.dev/ds/html without pulling Homestead
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: PARA vocabulary, editorial copy, and content semantics remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Authenticated source capture fixture feeding requirement-like records
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer wraps source-web with real checkout-owned source behavior and proves redacted source:v1 snapshots compose into records:v1 and enrichment:v1
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Real credentials, discovery, selectors, pacing values, and source-specific ETL profiles remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Cross-record corpus health and per-note profile verdicts over a PARA knowledge vault projected to records:v1
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer can run vault:v1 corpus health over its own records:v1 projection and surface the findings, while keeping its privacy heuristics, folder policy, and PII vocabulary downstream-owned
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Privacy heuristics, PII candidate detection, designated-folder policy, note vocabulary, and surface rendering remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Markdown/MDX frontmatter, wikilink, and inline-link projection into records:v1
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer can replace local note-to-record, wikilink, and inline-link projection helpers with the generic projection block while retaining its product configuration
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: PARA folder mapping, note vocabulary, Obsidian/Foam conventions, and rendering remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Heartwood-backed identity:v1 issuer and holder signatures for the credentials smoke
consumerPull.proofTarget: sovereign-citizen:reference:test proves real Ed25519 issue and present signatures through identity:v1
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Trust registry, default identity provider choice, secret persistence, and DID resolution remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Local-first white-label operator surface for vault tasks and agent handoffs
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer can build a local-surface:v1 manifest, DS-backed HTML, white-label launch plan, and quality:v1 report while keeping routes, screenshots, provider adapters, and product vocabulary downstream-owned
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: Server binding, route branding, storage adapters, provider setup, screenshots, and product UX remain downstream

consumerPull.downstreamUse: Sanctioned Astro/MDX component embed set over Refarm DS classes and CSS
consumerPull.proofTarget: a consumer can replace local dgk/vault/astro block packages with @refarm.dev/ds-astro imports while keeping product-specific MDX copy and route semantics downstream
consumerPull.ownershipBoundary: PARA labels, notebook/editorial vocabulary, custom routes, and product-specific blocks remain downstream

revendorPolicy.sameNameVersionBehavior: file: tarballs can keep the same package name and version while their bytes change during pre-publication handoff.
revendorPolicy.changedContentDetection: compare packages[].sha256 against the consumer vendor tarball and lockfile integrity
requiredWhenShaChanges: replace the matching vendor/*.tgz file from the same handoff directory
refresh the package-manager lockfile entry for the changed file: tarball
if the package manager keeps the old bytes, reinstall from a clean node_modules before running consumer proofs

availability.offlineBehavior: consumer can use copied vendor tarballs after SHA-256 verification

update.strategy: replace handoff directory and selected package tarballs

rollback.strategy: retain previous handoff directory or pinned consumer vendor tarballs
